notes: • Ideas: any page can now have a place. Tap "Set place…" under a page to name it and drop a pin on the map; the new Map tab shows every page that has a pin, and tapping one opens it. Pages without a place are untouched.

• Ideas: any page can now be a to-do, appointment or event. Tap "Schedule…" under a page to give it a date (and a time if you like); the new Calendar tab shows your month with each day's list, and to-dos tick off right there. Capturing an idea works exactly as before.

• Ideas: a page's Bubbles board can now go to Obsidian or any canvas app. In the vault popup, "Export this page's bubbles (.canvas)" saves your bubbles, their positions, colours and lines as an open .canvas file. The freehand diagram is not included.

• Ideas: take your pages to Obsidian or any Markdown notes app. The new vault button exports every page as a .md file (links, homes and extra places kept) in one zip, and imports .md files or a zipped vault back. Importing never deletes anything: pages with the same title are matched, your own writing is kept unless you choose to replace it, and one Undo reverts the whole import.

• Ideas: new ideas you jot down with + now wait in an Inbox at the top of your pages instead of cluttering the tree. When you are ready, use "File into…" to give an idea its home, and "Also file under…" to show it in more places without moving it. The new Outline tab lists every page under each place it is filed, and the Graph draws those extra places as dashed lines.

• Newstime: news now comes from 1,107 outlets worldwide. Tap a country on the News map, then "From France's press" (or that country's) to see what its own outlets cover most; on Sources, browse any country's most-read outlets, ranked, with a short note on why each ranks where it does. The feed can also rank stories by how many outlets or how many articles cover them.

• Dispatch: creating a new top-level project on a board that has a shared board mounted now asks "Where should it go?" — add it to the shared board (it syncs to your other devices and collaborators) or keep it on this device only. Local-only projects show a small "Local only" label. Projects stranded outside the shared board by earlier versions are picked up and synced within a couple of seconds of signing in. Viewers and commenters are not offered the shared board.

• NEW: Pine Composer — build TradingView Pine Script indicators from blocks you switch on and off, preview them on demo data, and copy the script. Stack layers (gold or inflation overlays, rolling regression channels), reorder, rename or colour them, or describe the view you want in a sentence and get a suggested setup. Works offline.

• NEW: Ideas — a place for notes that link together. Nest pages inside pages, link them with [[double brackets]] and see what links back, view a page as text, bubbles or a diagram, and open a graph of everything connected. Tap + to capture a thought in a second.

• NEW (Alpha): Stories — keep a novel, cartoon or film as a story: write each scene's script, sketch a rough storyboard panel by panel, and keep notes on characters, places and beats. Turning rough figures into finished drawings comes later; it is not in this Alpha.
